brief:
Three Palestinians were killed and several others wounded in an Israeli drone strike west of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Middle East Eye reported, citing medical sources via the Wafa news agency.

The attack targeted the area on Wednesday, according to the report. Medical officials did not immediately provide additional details about the casualties or the circumstances of the strike.
dek: Israeli attack on Gaza's Khan Younis kills three, wounds others Three Palestinians have been killed and several others wounded in an Israeli drone strike west of southern Gaza's Khan Younis, Wafa reports, citing medical sources.
title: Israeli drone strike kills three Palestinians in Khan Younis
